_comment: Later printings of library catalogue volumes whose page images the viewer shows (backlog item 51). edition_of names the volume Fankha cites, by library slug and volume number, and may correct it (set: columns, detach_catalogers: names); source_url is kept in the database only and never shown. Applied by catalogs:sync-editions.
